title: Inbox badge
summary: Render conditionally without the stray "0" that `count && …` produces.
prompt: Finish `Inbox`. Show an "Inbox" heading. With unread messages, show "You have N unread messages" ("1 unread message" for one). With all messages read, show no count at all. With no messages, show "No messages" and no list. Give every list item a stable key.
hints: `{0 && <p/>}` renders the number 0. Use `count > 0 && …` or a ternary.
Return early, or use a ternary, for the empty case.
